title: A rapid one-step kinetics-based immunoassay procedure for the highly-sensitive detection of C-reactive protein
protocol: Block the MTP wells by incubating with 300 μL of 5% (w/v) BSA for 30 min at 37 °C.
Wash the wells five times with 300 μL of wash buffer.
Filter the BSA solution prior to use to remove contaminants.
Dispense in the BSA-blocked MTP wells sequentially 2 µL of the diluted stock solution of anti-CRP capture Ab-bound Dynabeads (diluted 1:10 in binding buffer).
Add 38 μL of the binding buffer and 40 μL of biotinylated anti-CRP detection Ab (0.17 μg mL^-1^) pre-conjugated to SA-HRP (diluted 1:3000) sequentially.
Incubate at 37 °C for 15 min on a magnetic holder so that magnets capture the Dynabead-bound sandwich immune complex.
Remove excess reagents by sucking back the solution using a 300 µL multi-channel pipette.
Wash magnetically-captured sandwich immune complex-bound Dynabeads twice with washing buffer using a multi-channel pipette.
Suspend washed Dynabeads in 50 µL of binding buffer.
Add 100 µL of TMB-H2O2 mixture to each MTP well and incubate at room temperature for 4 min.
Stop the enzymatic reaction by adding 50 µL of 2N H2SO4 to each MTP well.
Measure absorbance at a wavelength of 450 nm with 540 nm as reference in Tecan Infinite M200 Pro microplate reader.
Determine the absorbance within 10 min of stopping the enzymatic reaction.
